Current report excerpt: ### Microsoft PowerToys version

0.89.0

### Installation method

PowerToys auto-update

### Running as admin

None

### Area(s) with issue?

ZoomIt

### Steps to reproduce

When starting my computer (with PowerToys automatically launched), I always have an error popup coming from ZoomIt extension, about a wrong hotkey parameter.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/397ba582-0c20-4c18-93ff-7727b3a88ae0)

Trying to change all the shortcuts, I was not able to find the one generating the issue.

But I realized the "Zoom In / Zoom Out animation" option is triggering it as well ! As soon as I'm trying to change that parameter, the error pops up, not matter what's the shortcut used (the one by default or any other custom one). This is happening both ways.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/874177e1-de9d-424d-a7a8-4430b0109b9b)
